description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the DefaultThrottlingConfig implementation related to the ThrottlingConfig interface, including mutability, equality, default values, value loading from configuration files, and rendering capabilities.

classes.name: DefaultThrottlingConfigTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that checks the immutability, correctness of equals/hashCode, default values, configuration loading, and rendering of DefaultThrottlingConfig objects.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks if DefaultThrottlingConfig instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultThrottlingConfig has correct equals and hashCode implementations.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that default values are returned when configuration is empty.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Checks that configuration file values are loaded correctly into ThrottlingConfig.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Tests rendering a ThrottlingConfig and reconstructing it back from the rendered Config.
